source.author: verg
source.text: ipse sed in pratis aries iam suave rubenti murice, iam croceo mutabit vellera luto; sponte sua sandyx pascentis vestiet agnos.
source.text_original: ipse sed in pratis aries iam suave rubenti / murice, iam croceo mutabit vellera luto; / sponte sua sandyx pascentis vestiet agnos.
source.text_english: But the ram himself, in the meadows, will now change his fleece, soft with reddening purple, now with saffron dye; of its own accord, scarlet will clothe the grazing lambs.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nec uarios discet mentiri lana colores, ipse sed in pratis aries iam suaue rubenti- murice, iam croceo mutabit uellera luto, sponte sua sandyx pascentis uestiet agnos.
reuse.text_original: nec uarios discet mentiri lana colores, ipse sed in pratis aries iam suaue rubenti- murice, iam croceo mutabit uellera luto, sponte sua sandyx pascentis uestiet agnos.
reuse.text_english: and wool will no longer learn to lie in varied colors; rather the ram himself, now in the meadows, will of his own accord change his fleece, now with sweetly glowing purple dye, now with saffron yellow ochre, and sandyx will clothe the grazing lambs of its own accord.
